name: Snow Cone Serenade
source:
A mysterious cold spell traps you in your cozy home. Your old dog Jedediah is sick and to top it all off, the heating suddenly breaks! Will you dare to enter a cursed world to fix it?

[From [url=https://potion-of-midi.itch.io/snow-cone-serenade]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一股神秘的寒流将你困在舒适的家中。你的老狗杰迪戴亚病了，最糟糕的是，暖气突然坏了！你敢进入一个被诅咒的世界来修复它吗？

[来自[url=https://potion-of-midi.itch.io/snow-cone-serenade]itch.io[/url]]
